描述_EN: porcelain bowl painted in underglaze blue with two five-clawed dragons among clouds, set between a wave border along the rim and a decorative band on the bottom part. the internal surface is plain except for the six characters of xuande reign mark within a double ring.
描述_ZN: 瓷碗在釉下青花中绘有两条五爪龙在云雾中，沿边的波浪形边框和底部的装饰带之间。 内壁除双环内有宣德年号六个字外，其余均为素面。
